name: Monkey365
what: An open-source PowerShell framework that collects configuration from Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Azure, checks it against security rules and reports findings with remediation guidance.
when: For a broader configuration review of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, Entra ID and Azure subscriptions in one run.
example: Build a parameter set with Instance `Microsoft365`, the services to collect (for example ExchangeOnline, MicrosoftTeams, SharePointOnline), IncludeEntraID and ExportTo `HTML`.
Run `Invoke-Monkey365` with those parameters and sign in when prompted.
Review the HTML report and assign each finding an owner and a due date.
pitfalls: What the scan can see depends on the permissions of the signed-in identity.
Rules are generic; tune or document exceptions for settings you have chosen on purpose.
Store reports securely; they describe your weaknesses in detail.
